q: What is Scope 4, and should we report it?
title: What is "Scope 4"?
short: Scope 4 is an informal name for avoided emissions: the emissions a product helps customers avoid compared with an alternative. It is not a GHG Protocol scope. Report it, if at all, separately from Scope 1, 2 and 3, with the comparison scenario stated, and never subtract it from your footprint.
audience: Companies selling efficient or low-carbon products

ul: State the reference product or scenario.
Show the calculation and its assumptions.
Keep it outside the inventory totals.

p: When the product clearly performs better than what it replaces, the reference is realistic, and your own Scope 1, 2 and 3 are reported in full beside it.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure behind a claim traceable to the invoices and bills it came from, so a reader can check the number rather than take the wording on trust.
